items.title: 債市風暴！全球長債「雪崩式」重定價：日債殖利率破3%創30年高 美債刺破4.8%
items.title_en: Bond Market Storm! Global Long‑Bond ‘Avalanche’ Repricing: Japan Yields Break 3% to 30‑Year High, US Yields Surge Past 4.8%
paras: 一場橫跨東京、法蘭克福、雪梨與紐約的同步拋售潮在周三(2日)席捲全球先進經濟體長債市場。日本10年期國債殖利率盤中突破3%，為1996年10月以來首見10年期美債衝上4.8%，創2025年1月來新高，30年期同步摸高5.28%；德國、澳洲10年期殖利率分別刷新15年與十餘年高點，彭博全球公債指數殖利率報3.72%，創2008年中以來最高。
專家指出，中東局勢推升油價造成通膨預期回歸，聯準會(Fed)主席華許在傑克森霍爾釋放鷹派訊號，CME FedWatch顯示9月升息機率由不足40%飆至近70%，巴克萊轉而預測9月、12月各升息1碼。
日本方面，美國財長貝森特在G20期間呼籲日本央行(BOJ)「進一步升息」，日本財務大臣片山皋月淡化貨幣政策討論，但市場認為BOJ本月升息概率已逼近99%，催動日債殖利率曲線陡峭化，10年期期限溢價達150基點，被安聯稱為「全球零成本資金時代終結的領先指標」。
匯率方面，日元在美日7月30日至8月26日豪擲15.3993兆日元(約965億美元)聯合干預後，仍貶回160附近，今年迄今干預規模27.13兆日元超過2003年，市場揣測東京恐被迫拋美債護盤。
更深層問題則是市場對財政信任打折。五礦證券尤春野指出，華許對通膨容忍度明顯下降，要求底層通膨「明確且快速」回2%；中金則認為「財政主導」下，Fedㄐㄧㄤ難置身事外。
當10年美債4.8%對應無風險收益，標普500滾動本益比26倍(盈利收益率僅3.7)，股債性價比落入負值，是近20年來配置框架未見的倒掛。
道明證券則指出，黃金短線上承壓，但長線牛市未終。業內人士警告，若10年期美債殖利率飆破5%，全球組合再平衡將不再是微調，而是對「無風險利率錨」本身的重估。從日債破3到美債逼5，市場正為過去40年的長債牛市舉行閉幕式。
paras_en: A synchronized sell‑off that spanned Tokyo, Frankfurt, Sydney and New York swept the long‑bond markets of advanced economies on Wednesday (the 2nd). Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield breached 3% intraday, the first time since October 1996; the US 10‑year yield jumped above 4.8%, a peak not seen since January 2025, while the 30‑year rose to 5.28%. Germany’s and Australia’s 10‑year yields each hit fresh 15‑year‑plus highs, and Bloomberg’s Global Aggregate Bond Index yield rose to 3.72%, the highest since mid‑2008.

Experts say that Middle‑East tensions have pushed oil prices up, reviving inflation expectations. Fed Chair Jerome Powell delivered a hawkish signal at Jackson Hole, and CME’s FedWatch showed the probability of a September rate hike climbing from under 40% to near 70%. Barclays now forecasts a 25‑basis‑point hike in both September and December.

In Japan, US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen urged the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to “further raise rates” during the G20, while Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki downplayed monetary‑policy debate. Nevertheless, the market now sees a near‑99% chance of a BOJ hike this month, steepening the Japanese yield curve and pushing the 10‑year term premium to 150 basis points – a metric Allianz calls a leading indicator that the era of “global zero‑cost funding” is ending.

On the currency front, after a coordinated intervention of ¥15.3993 trillion (about $96.5 billion) by Japan and the United States from July 30 to August 26, the yen still slipped back toward the ¥160 level. The cumulative intervention this year now totals ¥27.13 trillion, surpassing the 2003 record, leading markets to speculate that Tokyo may be forced to sell US Treasuries to support the yen.

A deeper issue is eroding confidence in fiscal policy. Wu Chun‑ye of Five Minerals Securities noted that Powell’s tolerance for inflation has clearly dropped, demanding that underlying inflation “clearly and quickly” return to 2%. Meanwhile, CICC argues that under a “fiscal‑driven” environment, the Fed will find it hard to stay out of the picture.

When the 10‑year US Treasury yields 4.8% represent a risk‑free return, the S&P 500’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio sits at 26× (earnings yield only 3.7%). The equity‑bond risk‑return ratio turns negative – a reversal not seen in the past two decades of asset‑allocation frameworks.

TD Securities points out that gold faces short‑term pressure but the long‑term bull market remains intact. Industry insiders warn that if the 10‑year US Treasury yield breaches 5%, global portfolio rebalancing will shift from a fine‑tuning exercise to a full‑scale reassessment of the “risk‑free rate anchor” itself. From Japan yields breaking 3% to US yields approaching 5%, the market is staging a closing ceremony for the 40‑year long‑bond bull run.

items.title: Fed鷹派聲浪踩煞車！威廉斯：升息理由還不夠
items.title_en: Fed Hawkish Tone Hits the Brakes! Williams: Not Enough Reason to Raise Rates
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周三(2日)表示，近期通膨數據令人鼓舞，隨著關稅造成的一次性價格衝擊逐漸消退，通膨正緩慢下降，目前尚無明確證據顯示Fed必須再次升息。
威廉斯接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，目前推升物價的主要因素仍是關稅，以及中東衝突造成的能源價格上漲，部分服務業通膨也依然偏高。不過，能源成本上升尚未擴散至其他服務項目，Fed也未觀察到關稅引發第二輪通膨效應，通膨預期仍受到控制。
威廉斯說：「最近的數據令人鼓舞。」隨著部分關稅影響逐漸成為過去，通膨趨勢正緩慢下滑，但目前仍無法確定現行貨幣政策是否足以確保未來一至兩年內讓通膨回到目標，或Fed是否必須採取進一步行動。
威廉斯支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月維持利率不變的決定，並認為目前利率處於適當位置，足以平衡充分就業與物價穩定的雙重使命。不過，他強調Fed仍在蒐集大量數據，之後必須重新評估政策立場。
Fed將於9月15日至16日在華盛頓召開利率會議，此前今年已連續5次按兵不動。7月會議有3名具投票權的官員主張升息1碼，顯示決策官員對政策限制程度看法不一。期貨市場一度反映，Fed本月將利率提高1碼至3.75%至4%的機率約達三分之二，但威廉斯的談話顯示，升息仍非板上釘釘。
身為Fed決策核心人物，威廉斯的立場通常代表政策辯論中的中間派看法。Fed在會議前還將取得一份最新通膨報告，市場也將關注Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(3日)的談話。
對於近期長期公債殖利率上升，威廉斯認為，主要反映美國經濟與成長前景強勁，以及AI、資料中心和科技領域的龐大投資需求，而非通膨失控或市場出現信用疑慮。
他表示，若未來出現持續性的生產力繁榮，確實可能推升不刺激也不抑制經濟的中性利率，但目前尚未看到足夠證據。威廉斯估計中性利率約為1%，實質利率雖略有上升，幅度仍相當有限。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair and New York Fed President John Williams said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that recent inflation data are encouraging, and as the one‑off price shock from tariffs fades, inflation is slowly easing, with no clear evidence that the Fed needs to raise rates again.

In an interview with CNBC, Williams noted that the main drivers of price pressures remain tariffs and higher energy prices due to the Middle‑East conflict, and some services inflation remains elevated. However, the rise in energy costs has not yet spread to other services, the Fed has not seen a second‑round inflation effect from tariffs, and inflation expectations remain under control.

Williams said, “The recent data are encouraging.” As the impact of some tariffs recedes, the inflation trend is gradually sliding down, but it is still uncertain whether the current monetary policy is sufficient to bring inflation back to target over the next one to two years, or whether the Fed must take further action.

Williams supported the Federal Open Market Committee’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and said the current rate level is appropriate to balance the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. He emphasized, however, that the Fed is still gathering a large amount of data and will have to reassess its policy stance later.

The Fed will hold its rate‑policy meeting in Washington on September 15‑16, after five consecutive pauses this year. At the July meeting, three voting members advocated a one‑basis‑point hike, showing differing views among policymakers on how restrictive policy should be. Futures once priced a roughly two‑thirds chance that the Fed would raise rates by one basis point to 3.75%‑4% this month, but Williams’s comments suggest a hike is not a foregone conclusion.

As a core member of the Fed’s decision‑making team, Williams’s stance usually reflects a centrist view in policy debates. The Fed will also receive a fresh inflation report before the meeting, and markets will watch Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Thursday (the 3rd).

Regarding the recent rise in long‑term Treasury yields, Williams said it mainly reflects a strong U.S. economy and growth outlook, as well as massive investment demand in AI, data centers and the tech sector, rather than runaway inflation or credit concerns in the market.

He added that if a sustained productivity boom materializes, it could indeed push the neutral rate higher—neither stimulating nor restraining the economy—but there is not enough evidence yet. Williams estimates the neutral rate at about 1%, and while real rates have risen slightly, the increase remains modest.

items.title: 黃金賣壓即將枯竭！德銀：鷹派Fed也難阻擋金屬走強、下一輪上漲或由主動資金接棒
items.title_en: Gold Selling Pressure Near Exhaustion! Deutsche Bank: Even a Hawkish Fed Won’t Stop Metals Rally, Next Upswing May Be Driven by Active Capital
paras: 黃金市場可能正走到一個重要轉折點。德意志銀行最新研究指出，近期推升金價的重要力量之一系統性交易資金（CTA）已經買進不少，買盤逐漸接近尾聲；另一方面，黃金市場的賣壓也可能快要耗盡。德銀認為，這種情況可能讓黃金展現比預期更強的韌性，即使聯準會（Fed）釋出鷹派訊號，金價也未必會因此大幅走弱。若賣壓進一步減少，下一波買盤甚至可能由目前尚未大舉進場的主動型投資人接手。
德意志銀行金屬研究主管Daniel Ghali在週二（1日）發布報告指出，過去1個月黃金現貨市場出現大規模賣出，賣壓程度已達近5年來相當高的水準，主要來自商業及零售投資人。
與此同時，CTA卻大舉買進，持倉規模一度達到歷史最大部位的33%。
不過，真正依據市場及基本面判斷、主動進行交易的資金，並沒有跟著大量進場。德銀追蹤的相關數據顯示，這類主動型資金在整個夏末行情中幾乎沒有增加持倉，相關指標甚至已較8月高點下降60%。
德銀認為，目前黃金市場的重要變化是，賣方可能快賣完了。報告指出，金價必須跌破每盎司4315美元，才可能觸發CTA下一輪系統性賣出。
也就是說，只要金價維持在4315美元上方，一般性的價格下跌未必會讓量化交易資金跟著大規模砍倉，因此不容易出現演算法交易引發的連鎖賣壓。
反過來，如果金價重新上漲，CTA反而可能需要買回近期已經平掉的多頭部位。
這使目前黃金市場出現一種對多頭較有利的結構：金價下跌需要新的賣壓，但市場原本的賣壓可能已逐漸減少；如果金價上漲，CTA反而可能重新進場買進。

這波黃金漲勢 CTA在買 主動型資金卻沒跟上

德銀進一步發現，本輪黃金上漲背後的資金結構並不平均。市場近期不斷討論去美元化、資產多元化、貨幣貶值及政府財政等因素，但從資金流向來看，並沒有證據顯示主動型投資人因此大舉買進黃金。
同時，倫敦金銀市場協會（LBMA）的現貨交易量也相對低迷，進一步顯示市場沒有出現大量、但尚未被追蹤到的現貨資金流入。
期權市場則出現一些不同訊號，未平倉合約增加，代表部分資金正透過期權押注金價上漲，但直接買進黃金的多頭資金仍不算明顯。
德銀也注意到，CTA大舉買進期間，黃金市場出現一些不尋常的價格變化。包括利率沒有隨著演算法買盤增加而下降、CME活躍期貨合約的漲幅明顯大於其他期貨合約，以及金價與CTA資金流之間的關聯程度異常高。
德銀認為，這些現象代表市場吸收買盤的能力受到限制，部分市場參與者承受的資金壓力較大，因此需要透過其他方式消化大量期貨買盤。

聯準會釋出鷹派訊號 金價未必大跌

在這種市場結構下，德銀認為，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）的鷹派表態，對金價的實際影響可能沒有表面看起來那麼大。
一般來說，聯準會釋出偏鷹訊號、升息預期升高，往往會對黃金形成壓力。但德銀認為，現在的問題在於，市場上的賣壓已經很大，而且可能逐漸接近尾聲。
德銀指出，CTA必須等到金價跌破每盎司4315美元，才可能觸發下一輪大規模賣出。因此，只要金價沒有跌破這個價位，即使聯準會繼續釋出鷹派訊號，也不代表CTA就會立即大舉砍倉。
相反的，一旦金價重新走高，CTA可能被迫買回近期平掉的多頭部位，進一步增加市場買盤。
因此，德銀認為目前黃金對下跌與上漲的反應可能並不對稱：下跌不一定會帶來大量新的賣單，但上漲反而可能吸引量化資金重新買進。

賣壓減少後 主動型資金可能接棒

隨著CTA買盤逐漸接近尾聲、現貨市場賣壓也可能耗盡，德銀預期，下一階段可能由主動型裁量交易者成為新的買家。
德銀指出，當市場賣壓減弱後，這類主動型投資人可能在目前價位附近開始進場。
去美元化、資產多元化、貨幣貶值及財政主導等4項市場題材，雖然目前還沒有帶來大規模資金流入，但相關因素並未消失。一旦市場阻力降低，這些題材可能重新吸引主動型資金。
因此，德銀對黃金市場的判斷可以簡單歸納為：CTA已經買了很多、賣方也快賣完，而真正的主動型買家還沒大舉進場，共同構成黃金在傑克遜霍爾會議前後抵禦鷹派衝擊、甚至逆勢走強的潛在基礎。

白銀多頭訊號更強 銅市也受到關注

除了黃金，德銀也看好白銀的短線表現。報告指出，CTA目前高度偏向買進白銀，預計下一個交易日將增加相當於最大持倉8%的部位。如果白銀價格持續上漲，CTA未來一週的增持規模甚至可能達到最大持倉的15%。
更重要的是，如果白銀價格下跌，量化交易資金進一步賣出的壓力已經非常有限；但如果價格上漲，CTA反而可能繼續追買。
此外，白銀現貨資金流在各種貴金屬中表現最強，零售需求也持續承接其他投資人的平倉賣出，形成較強的短線做多訊號。不過，德銀提醒，倫敦市場目前實體白銀供應充足，可能限制未來遠期升水的上升空間。
銅市場則呈現不同情況。CTA目前已處於高度偏多的狀態，但德銀認為，市場整體對銅的看多程度仍然不足。
德銀指出，LME 3個月期銅跌破每噸13,880美元，可能是下一個重要的量化賣出觸發價位。不過，在供應非常吃緊的情況下，目前銅價仍守住這個區域。
德銀甚至認為，銅市場可能正接近一種非常罕見的極端狀態，這類情況大約每10年才會出現一次，而市場目前最關鍵的問題是：全球地面上的銅庫存，到底還剩多少可以買？
至於鋁，德銀預期CTA在幾乎所有價格情境下都會持續買進，目前交易日預計增加相當於最大持倉7%的部位；如果LME 3個月期鋁升至每噸3,335美元附近，增持幅度可能擴大至16%。
鈀金則是另一種情況。德銀認為，CTA近期的空頭回補可能接近尾聲，市場重新建立程式化空頭部位的條件已逐漸成熟。
paras_en: Gold markets may be reaching a pivotal turning point. Deutsche Bank’s latest research notes that one of the recent key drivers of price gains – systematic trading capital (CTA) – has already bought a substantial amount, and its buying is winding down; at the same time, selling pressure in the gold market may be close to running out. Deutsche Bank believes this could give gold stronger resilience than expected, so even if the Federal Reserve signals hawkishness, gold prices may not weaken sharply. If selling pressure eases further, the next wave of buying could be taken up by active investors who have not yet entered in force.

Deutsche Bank metals research head Daniel Ghali said in a Tuesday (the 1st) report that the past month saw massive sell‑offs in the spot gold market, with selling pressure reaching a level not seen in almost five years, driven mainly by commercial and retail investors.
At the same time, CTAs have been buying aggressively, with positions at one point reaching 33% of the historically largest allocation.

However, truly market‑driven, fundamentals‑based active capital has not followed suit. Deutsche Bank’s tracking data show that this type of active capital barely added any positions during the late‑summer rally, and related indicators have fallen about 60% from the August peak.
Deutsche Bank sees a key shift: sellers may be nearly finished. The report says gold would have to fall below $4,315 per ounce before it could trigger the next systematic CTA sell‑off.
In other words, as long as gold stays above $4,315, a routine price dip is unlikely to prompt quantitative traders to slash positions en masse, so algorithm‑driven cascade selling is less likely.
Conversely, if gold climbs again, CTAs may need to buy back the long positions they recently closed out.

This creates a structure that favours bulls: a price drop would need fresh selling pressure, but the original selling pressure appears to be waning; if price rises, CTAs could re‑enter on the buy side.

This gold rally is being driven by CTAs, while active capital lags behind. Deutsche Bank finds the funding mix behind the current rise uneven. Although the market is buzzing about de‑dollarisation, asset diversification, currency depreciation and fiscal issues, there is no evidence that active investors are buying gold in large volumes as a result.
At the same time, spot turnover on the London Bullion Market Association (LBMA) remains relatively weak, further indicating that there is no large, untracked inflow of spot capital.
The options market shows a different signal: open interest is rising, suggesting some funds are betting on higher gold prices via options, yet outright long buying of physical gold remains modest.

Deutsche Bank also notes that during the CTA buying surge, the gold market displayed some unusual price behaviour, including rates not falling despite algorithmic buying, CME front‑month futures gaining markedly more than other contracts, and an unusually high correlation between price moves and CTA flows.

The bank interprets these signs as evidence that the market’s capacity to absorb buying is limited, putting pressure on certain participants and forcing them to find other ways to digest the large futures inflow.

Fed Hawkish Signals May Not Drag Gold Down. In this market structure, Deutsche Bank believes that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish remarks may have less impact on gold than they appear to on the surface.
Typically, a hawkish Fed stance and higher rate‑rise expectations weigh on gold. Deutsche Bank argues that the current issue is that selling pressure is already high and may be nearing its end.

The bank points out that CTAs would only trigger a new wave of large‑scale selling if gold slips below $4,315 per ounce. Therefore, as long as price stays above that level, even continued hawkish Fed signals won’t automatically lead to massive CTA liquidations.
Conversely, a renewed price rise could force CTAs to repurchase the longs they recently closed, adding further buying pressure.
Thus, Deutsche Bank sees an asymmetry: a decline may not generate a flood of new sell orders, while an upswing could attract quantitative capital back into the market.

Selling Pressure Diminishes, Active Capital May Take Over. As CTA buying winds down and spot‑market selling pressure dries up, Deutsche Bank expects the next phase to be led by discretionary, active traders.
The bank notes that once market‑wide selling eases, these active investors could start entering around current price levels.

Although de‑dollarisation, diversification, currency depreciation and fiscal themes have not yet sparked large inflows, the underlying factors remain and could re‑attract active capital if market resistance eases.

In short, Deutsche Bank’s view is that CTAs have bought heavily, sellers are almost done, and true active buyers have not yet entered in force – a combination that could help gold weather the Fed’s hawkish shock around the Jackson Hole meeting and even move higher against the trend.

Silver Bullish Signals Stronger, Copper Also in Focus. Besides gold, Deutsche Bank is upbeat on silver’s short‑term outlook. The report says CTAs are currently heavily net‑long silver and are expected to add positions equal to about 8% of their maximum allocation the next trading day. If silver keeps rising, weekly additions could reach 15% of the maximum position.
More importantly, if silver falls, the pressure from quantitative sellers is already very limited; but if price climbs, CTAs may continue to add to their longs.

Silver spot inflows are the strongest among precious metals, and retail demand is still absorbing other investors’ position‑closing sales, creating a solid short‑term bullish signal. However, Deutsche Bank cautions that physical silver supply in London is ample, which may cap future forward‑curve premiums.
Copper shows a different picture. CTAs are currently very net‑long copper, but Deutsche Bank believes overall market bullishness on copper remains insufficient.

The bank says a break below $13,880 per tonne on the LME three‑month contract could trigger the next significant quantitative sell‑off, though tight supply is currently keeping copper prices within that band.

Deutsche Bank even suggests the copper market may be approaching an extremely rare extreme state that occurs roughly once every decade, with the key question being how much on‑ground copper inventory remains available for purchase.

As for aluminium, Deutsche Bank expects CTAs to keep buying under almost any price scenario, with a planned increase of about 7% of the maximum allocation today; if the LME three‑month aluminium price approaches $3,335 per tonne, the addition could rise to 16%.
Palladium is a different story. Deutsche Bank believes recent short covering by CTAs is nearing its end, and conditions are gradually maturing for the market to rebuild programmed short positions.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價回落抵消美債殖利率壓力 主要指數變動不大
paras: 美股主要指數周三(2日)開盤變動不大，油價自高檔回落，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，但美債殖利率仍處於多年高點，持續壓抑投資人風險偏好。
西德州中級原油跌破每桶90美元，中止因美伊爭奪荷姆茲海峽控制權而引發的連兩日漲勢；美國10年期公債殖利率在觸及兩年高點後大致持平。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近260點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近20點或0.07%，標普 500 指數漲近0.1%，費城半導體指數跌近0.1%。台積電 ADR 漲近0.3%。
國際油價中止連日漲勢，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，美股期指周三(2日)盤前收斂跌幅，美國公券價格同步走高。不過，全球公債殖利率仍上升壓力，加上主要央行可能在本月升息，市場情緒依然謹慎。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨大致持平。戴爾科技(DELL-US)受強勁營收預測激勵，盤前股價上漲。歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.3%，亞洲股市創兩周來最大跌幅，美元變動不大。
布蘭特原油在連續兩個交易日上漲後回落至每桶94美元附近。美國公債逆勢上揚，30年期美債殖利率下跌2個基點至5.25%，但其他多數市場的債券價格仍然走低。周三公布的ADP數據顯示，美國8月民間就業人口增加3.8萬人，低於預期，反映勞動市場招聘動能放緩。
油價回落暫時減輕市場壓力。此前能源價格持續上漲，加深投資人對通膨再度升溫的憂慮，也使原本已受到政府大舉舉債及企業融資需求壓迫的債市進一步走弱。
交易員目前預估，包括聯準會(Fed)在內的三家主要央行，本月升息機率均已超過50%，其中Fed升息機率約為65%。ING策略師Chris Turner指出，市場新的基本假設似乎已轉為Fed終究會在9月升息。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)已清楚表明，通膨下降速度仍不足以回到目標，加上經濟維持一定韌性，Fed可能必須採取行動。
儘管全球債市承受賣壓，但殖利率升幅相對溫和，仍為交易員帶來些許安慰。法國巴黎銀行財富管理策略師Stephan Kemper表示，本輪債市下跌有秩序且範圍廣泛，並非由信用風險或流動性壓力引發，顯示市場正在反映利率將在更長時間維持高檔，而不是預示信用危機或經濟衰退。
Kemper認為，殖利率能否回落的關鍵仍在通膨預期。如果長天期殖利率壓力獲得緩解，考量企業基本面依然強勁，股市可能出現大幅上漲。企業現金部位在AI支出激增之際仍重返歷史高點，也為股市提供支撐。今年全球股票市場已吸引約1.1兆美元資金，創2021年以來最大流入。
不過，Global Gate Asset Management策略師Patrik Lang警告，一旦美國與日本公債殖利率突破目前阻力區，股市韌性可能受到考驗。目前投資人部位偏高，短期指標也進入超買區，無論基本面如何，未來數周市場均可能進入整理。

items.title: 波克夏為何狂買Alphabet？阿貝爾親揭關鍵原因
items.title_en: Why Berkshire Is Buying Alphabet in a Frenzy? Abel Reveals the Key Reason
paras: 波克夏海瑟威(BRK.A-US)(BRK.B-US)執行長阿貝爾(Greg Abel)周三(2日)表示，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)是人工智慧(AI)領域的「重要參與者」。波克夏第二季大舉加碼Alphabet，使其一躍成為公司股票投資組合的第三大持股。
阿貝爾接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，波克夏可從旗下企業實際運用AI的情況，清楚掌握這項技術帶來的影響及效益，因而進一步提高投資興趣，同時看好Google在AI競賽中的強勢地位。
阿貝爾透露，波克夏15個月前以折價6.5%的條件，取得價值100億美元的Google持股。當時交易規模尚未確定，但對方建議波克夏考慮投入100億美元，阿貝爾隨後與巴菲特(Warren Buffett)討論投資金額及折價幅度，最終完成交易。
根據波克夏8月向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的第二季持股資料，公司當季增持總值約170億美元的Alphabet股票，成為該季最大規模的新增投資。截至最新申報，波克夏持有約1.06億股Alphabet A類與C類股票，按目前市價計算，價值約366億美元。
除Alphabet外，波克夏第二季也大舉加碼達美航空(DAL-US)，持股規模增加44%，增持價值約16億美元。不過Alphabet在波克夏投資組合中的地位明顯提升，凸顯阿貝爾與巴菲特對其AI發展潛力的信心。
Google與微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)並列五大超大規模雲端服務業者，正投入鉅額資本支出，擴充運行AI所需的資料中心與運算能力。
高盛(GS-US)估計，2026年全球超大規模雲端業者資本支出可能接近1兆美元，但各機構預測差異相當大。高盛研究人員指出，市場普遍引用的7,940億美元預測，可能低估全球AI資本支出約2,000億美元，卻也可能高估美國境內AI投資相同金額。
對投資人而言，關鍵仍是這些龐大支出何時能轉化為回報。高盛警告，若AI運算需求持續由模型訓練主導，企業在廣泛商業化之前仍須不斷投入資本支出與研發經費，投資報酬實現的時間可能進一步延後。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US)(BRK.B-US) CEO Greg Abel told CNBC on Wednesday (Feb. 2) that Alphabet (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US), Google’s parent company, is a "key player" in the AI arena. Berkshire’s second‑quarter investment in Alphabet surged, making it the company’s third‑largest holding in its equity portfolio.

Abel said Berkshire can clearly see the impact and benefits of AI through its subsidiaries’ actual use of the technology, which has further increased its investment interest and confidence in Google’s strong position in the AI race.

Abel revealed that Berkshire acquired $10 billion of Google shares 15 months ago at a 6.5% discount. At the time the transaction size was not yet determined, but the counterparty suggested Berkshire consider investing $10 billion. Abel then discussed the investment amount and discount with Warren Buffett, and the deal was ultimately completed.

According to Berkshire’s second‑quarter holdings filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in August, the company increased its Alphabet stake by about $17 billion, the largest new investment of the quarter. As of the latest filing, Berkshire holds roughly 106 million shares of Alphabet Class A and C, valued at about $36.6 billion at current prices.

In addition to Alphabet, Berkshire also significantly increased its stake in Delta Air Lines (DAL-US) in the second quarter, raising its holdings by 44% and adding about $1.6 billion. However, Alphabet’s prominence in Berkshire’s portfolio has clearly risen, underscoring Abel’s and Buffett’s confidence in its AI growth potential.

Google, Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US), Amazon (AMZN-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) are the five largest hyperscale cloud providers, all investing heavily in capital expenditures to expand the data centers and computing power needed to run AI.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) estimates that global hyperscale cloud spend could approach $1 trillion in 2026, but forecasts vary widely. Goldman research notes that the commonly cited $794 billion figure may underestimate global AI capital spend by about $200 billion, while possibly overestimating U.S.‑based AI investment by the same amount.

For investors, the key question remains when these massive expenditures will translate into returns. Goldman warns that if AI compute demand continues to be dominated by model training, companies will need to keep investing in capital and R&D before widespread commercialization, potentially delaying the realization of investment returns.

items.title: 聯鈞7月自結獲利1.48億元、年增279% 下半年擴產滿足客戶出貨
paras: 光通訊股聯鈞(3450)近日股價波動劇烈，遭主管機關要求公告財務資料，聯鈞自結公告上(7)月份單月稅後純益為1.48億元、年增高達279%，每股純益為1.02元。聯鈞今(2026)年第2季受惠光學產品占比持續攀升，單季EPS達2.09元，累計上半年EPS已達2.78元，已達去(2025)年獲利50％以上，前7月累計EPS為3.8元。
聯鈞股價近期也隨著業績轉佳，推升股價從7月底波段低點的338.5元，一路上漲至今日602元，波段漲幅逾7成以上。
聯鈞在法說上表示，儘管相關供應鏈已積極擴產，但AI光通訊供給量仍遠落後市場需求，預期未來幾年AI產品相關短缺情況仍持續延續，聯鈞也將持續加速擴產，以滿足客戶快速出貨的相關需求，公司董事會將陸續通過籌資案，擴大資本支出擴產。
法人表示，聯鈞近年受惠於AI帶動高速、寬頻傳輸需求快速提升，旗下COSA光學次模組產品涵蓋65G、100G至200G EML晶片，持續站穩全球委外COSA封裝領導地位，產能訂單以每年翻倍程度增長。

items.title: 友達出售新加坡廠處予威騰電子 交易金額87億元
items.title_en: AUO Sells Singapore Plant to Western Digital for 8.75 Billion NTD
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(2)日公告，將子公司AFPD位於新加坡的廠房及相關廠務附屬設施，出售給硬碟大廠威騰電子(Western Digital)，交易總金額為新加坡幣3.5億元(約新台幣 87.53億元)。
AFPD此次出售廠房的建物面積約17.7萬平方公尺(約5.35萬坪)，另有附屬設備一批，交易相對人為Western Digital (Singapore)，友達表示，處分目的為聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構。
AFPD將提出OTP予買方簽署，並提供10個營業日的選擇權期間(Option Period)，過戶前提條件將視買方是否取得當地主管機關包括但不限於Jurong Town Corporation之核准，預計處分利益待買方取得核准後確認。
友達董事長彭双浪於最近一次法說中提到，公司持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭等新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: AUO (2409-TW) announced today that it will sell its subsidiary AFPD’s plant and related facilities in Singapore to Western Digital for a total transaction amount of SGD 350 million (approximately NTD 8.753 billion).

The AFPD plant covers about 177,000 square meters (approximately 53,500 ping) and includes a batch of ancillary equipment; the counterparty is Western Digital (Singapore). AUO stated that the disposal aims to focus on a light‑asset operating model, activate assets, and optimize its financial structure.

AFPD will issue an offer to purchase (OTP) for the buyer to sign and provide a 10‑business‑day option period. Transfer conditions will depend on whether the buyer obtains approval from local authorities, including but not limited to the Jurong Town Corporation; the disposal proceeds are expected to be confirmed once approval is obtained.

In a recent earnings call, AUO Chairman Peng Shuanglang reiterated the company’s continued focus on a light‑asset operating model, asset activation, and financial structure optimization, and on phasing out less competitive legacy lines while investing in high‑yield applications such as AI’s four‑arrow technologies.

items.title: 債市殖利率飆高對股市是「好事」？小摩：反映經濟強勁
paras: 全球債券市場殖利率近期持續攀升，日本、德國與英國10年期公債殖利率分別升至30年、15年及18年來高點。不過，市場並非一致認為利率走高將對股市構成壓力，部分經濟學家與投資策略師反而認為，殖利率上升反映經濟成長動能強勁，未必是股市的壞消息。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，經濟學家Matthew C. Klein週二（1日）在Substack發表一篇文章，主張「債券殖利率上升其實是好事」，因為這反映出強勁的經濟成長。目前收入與支出年增率達7%，資本需求也十分強勁，尤其是在AI基礎設施持續擴建的情況下。
他同時指出，這也是2008年全球金融危機後、長期失衡的低利率時代逐步回歸正常的過程。Klein認為：「太多人把低利率視為正常現象，這其實是深層社會病態的症狀。」
他也指出，雖然許多評論人士將債券殖利率上升歸因於不可持續的財政赤字，但「截至目前，美國經濟數據完全沒有顯示經濟即將放緩的跡象」。
事實上，Klein認為，在聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）上週五發表鷹派言論後，市場目前對聯準會9月升息可能性的預期升高，這「大致上仍是好消息」。
他還認為，與過去相比，美國消費支出及企業投資對信貸條件的敏感度都已明顯下降。
摩根大通策略師Mislav Matejka週二公布下半年展望時，同樣對債券殖利率走高抱持相對淡定的態度。他表示，目前沒有理由認為殖利率上升將成為股市無法克服的障礙，因為利率攀升反映的是經濟活動動能更加強勁。
全球股市進一步上漲的動力包括企業獲利表現強勁、每股盈餘（EPS）預估持續上修、各國央行最終採取的緊縮措施可能低於投資人目前的擔憂，且採購經理人指數（PMI）的反彈，亦顯示經濟活動動能正在增強。
Matejka指出，歐洲PMI修正值已連續3個月上升，進一步強化他對歐洲股市及國際股市的投資論點。如果美元指數見頂，也將為歐洲及國際股市提供額外支撐。
至於美元走勢，Matejka認為市場對升息的預期已相當鷹派，進一步轉向更鷹派的空間有限。因此，儘管自荷姆茲海峽危機爆發以來，美元一度扮演某種避險資產角色，但後續美元可能重新走弱。
這項變化也可能為近期大幅回落的黃金帶來支撐。自中東爆發戰事以來，金價已下跌約20%至25%。
Matejka預期金價將反彈，並認為市場可能重新關注所謂的「貶值交易」，也就是在法定貨幣價值面臨下滑時，偏好具抗通膨及避險特性的實體資產。
有利於國際股市的另一項因素是估值。Matejka認為，美股目前約為未來盈餘的20倍，估值已顯得「偏高」，但國際股市及新興市場的估值相對便宜。
MSCI全球全市場指數在2025年已較美股領先15個百分點，今年以來也領先約4%，該報告預期這項趨勢將持續。摩根大通給予標普500指數年底目標價8,000點，較目前水準高出約3%。
Matejka維持加碼新興市場、減碼已開發市場的投資建議，並點名記憶體產業趨勢趨於穩定，以及中國經濟復甦，可能成為推動新興市場進一步上漲的潛在因素。

items.title: 聯鈞7月自結獲利1.48億元、年增279% 下半年擴產滿足客戶出貨
paras: 光通訊股聯鈞(3450)近日股價波動劇烈，遭主管機關要求公告財務資料，聯鈞自結公告上(7)月份單月稅後純益為1.48億元、年增高達279%，每股純益為1.02元。聯鈞今(2026)年第2季受惠光學產品占比持續攀升，單季EPS達2.09元，累計上半年EPS已達2.78元，已達去(2025)年獲利50％以上，前7月累計EPS為3.8元。
聯鈞股價近期也隨著業績轉佳，推升股價從7月底波段低點的338.5元，一路上漲至今日602元，波段漲幅逾7成以上。
聯鈞在法說上表示，儘管相關供應鏈已積極擴產，但AI光通訊供給量仍遠落後市場需求，預期未來幾年AI產品相關短缺情況仍持續延續，聯鈞也將持續加速擴產，以滿足客戶快速出貨的相關需求，公司董事會將陸續通過籌資案，擴大資本支出擴產。
法人表示，聯鈞近年受惠於AI帶動高速、寬頻傳輸需求快速提升，旗下COSA光學次模組產品涵蓋65G、100G至200G EML晶片，持續站穩全球委外COSA封裝領導地位，產能訂單以每年翻倍程度增長。

items.title: 友達出售新加坡廠處予威騰電子 交易金額87億元
items.title_en: AUO Sells Singapore Plant to Western Digital for 8.75 Billion NTD
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(2)日公告，將子公司AFPD位於新加坡的廠房及相關廠務附屬設施，出售給硬碟大廠威騰電子(Western Digital)，交易總金額為新加坡幣3.5億元(約新台幣 87.53億元)。
AFPD此次出售廠房的建物面積約17.7萬平方公尺(約5.35萬坪)，另有附屬設備一批，交易相對人為Western Digital (Singapore)，友達表示，處分目的為聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構。
AFPD將提出OTP予買方簽署，並提供10個營業日的選擇權期間(Option Period)，過戶前提條件將視買方是否取得當地主管機關包括但不限於Jurong Town Corporation之核准，預計處分利益待買方取得核准後確認。
友達董事長彭双浪於最近一次法說中提到，公司持續聚焦輕資產營運模式、活化資產及優化財務結構，透過淘汰競爭力較低的低世代線，投資 AI 四支箭等新技術等高殖化應用。
paras_en: AUO (2409-TW) announced today that it will sell its subsidiary AFPD’s plant and related facilities in Singapore to Western Digital for a total transaction amount of SGD 350 million (approximately NTD 8.753 billion).

The AFPD plant covers about 177,000 square meters (approximately 53,500 ping) and includes a batch of ancillary equipment; the counterparty is Western Digital (Singapore). AUO stated that the disposal aims to focus on a light‑asset operating model, activate assets, and optimize its financial structure.

AFPD will issue an offer to purchase (OTP) for the buyer to sign and provide a 10‑business‑day option period. Transfer conditions will depend on whether the buyer obtains approval from local authorities, including but not limited to the Jurong Town Corporation; the disposal proceeds are expected to be confirmed once approval is obtained.

In a recent earnings call, AUO Chairman Peng Shuanglang reiterated the company’s continued focus on a light‑asset operating model, asset activation, and financial structure optimization, and on phasing out less competitive legacy lines while investing in high‑yield applications such as AI’s four‑arrow technologies.

items.title: 晶片不在美國生產就課稅！盧特尼克：台灣下周再宣布最高300億美元投資
items.title_en: Semiconductors Not Made in the U.S. Will Be Taxed! Lutnick: Taiwan to Announce Up to $30 Billion Investment Next Week
paras: 美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)周三(2日)表示，川普政府正考慮對進口半導體祭出新一輪關稅，並可能將課稅範圍擴大至搭載晶片的資料中心伺服器與消費性電子產品，藉此吸引更多晶片製造回流美國。
不過，新關稅預料將搭配赴美投資豁免機制，仿照川普政府對製藥業採取的模式。盧特尼克接受《CNBC》訪問時表示：「如果在美國生產，我們會提供關稅減免；如果不在美國生產，就得繳納關稅。」
川普今年1月已在美國商務部完成貿易調查後，對部分先進半導體課徵25%關稅。新一輪措施可能進一步擴大涵蓋範圍，不僅針對晶片本身，也涵蓋含有晶片的進口產品。批評者警告，此舉可能推高在美國興建資料中心的成本，但盧特尼克認為，提供本土製造豁免可望降低相關衝擊。
盧特尼克表示，目前各企業承諾投入美國半導體製造的金額已達約1.2兆美元，其中包括台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)及美光(MU-US)等公司。部分投資來自今年稍早完成的美台貿易協議，台灣承諾提供約5,000億美元投資與信用保證，以支持美國高科技製造。
他並預告，台灣下周將再宣布一批新的對美投資承諾，規模約200億至300億美元。

加拿大臨時加碼要求導致談判破局

談及美加貿易協議破局，盧特尼克再次將責任歸咎於加拿大，聲稱加方純粹出於政治理由，在最後關頭讓談判告吹，導致雙方未能在期限前達成協議，以阻止美國對加拿大商品加徵50%關稅。
盧特尼克表示，就在談判期限屆滿前幾個小時，加拿大代表團突然加入一些「瘋狂構想」，其中包括針對中型與重型卡車提出額外要求，使原本接近完成的協議生變。
他回憶，當時曾直接詢問一名加拿大部長：「你們是真的想讓談判破局嗎？」對方回答：「我不能說。」盧特尼克據此認為，加拿大是基於政治考量刻意中止談判。
不過，盧特尼克也承認，美方可能同樣在最後一刻提出新的要求，因為川普先前曾表示，這聽起來確實像是他可能採取的做法。雙方目前仍各說各話，持續互相指責對方應為貿易協議告吹負責。
paras_en: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick on Wednesday (Feb. 2) said the Trump administration is considering a new round of tariffs on imported semiconductors and may expand the scope to data‑center servers and consumer electronics that contain chips, in an effort to bring more chip manufacturing back to the United States.

However, the new tariffs are expected to be paired with a U.S. investment exemption mechanism, modeled after the Trump administration’s approach to the pharmaceutical industry. In a CNBC interview, Lutnick said, “If it’s made in the U.S., we’ll offer tariff relief; if it’s not made in the U.S., it will be taxed.”

Trump imposed a 25% tariff on certain advanced semiconductors in January after a trade review by the U.S. Commerce Department. The new measures could broaden the coverage to include not only the chips themselves but also imported products that contain chips. Critics warn that this could raise the cost of building data centers in the U.S., but Lutnick believes that providing domestic manufacturing exemptions can mitigate the impact.

Lutnick said that companies have already committed about $1.2 trillion to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing, including TSMC (2330‑TW) and Micron (MU‑US). Some of the investment comes from a U.S.–Taiwan trade agreement signed earlier this year, under which Taiwan pledged roughly $500 billion in investment and credit guarantees to support U.S. high‑tech manufacturing.
He also announced that Taiwan will announce another batch of U.S. investment commitments next week, in the range of $20 billion to $30 billion.

Canada’s last‑minute demands caused the trade talks to collapse. Lutnick again blamed Canada, claiming the country acted purely for political reasons and let the negotiations fail at the last moment, preventing an agreement before the deadline and stopping the U.S. from imposing a 50% tariff on Canadian goods.

Lutnick said that just hours before the deadline, the Canadian delegation suddenly introduced some “crazy ideas,” including additional demands on medium‑ and heavy‑truck imports, which derailed an almost‑completed agreement.

He recalled asking a Canadian minister directly, “Do you really want to let the negotiations collapse?” The minister replied, “I can’t say.” Lutnick concluded that Canada deliberately halted the talks for political reasons.

Nonetheless, Lutnick admitted that the U.S. may have also made new demands at the last minute, as Trump had previously indicated that such a move would be consistent with his approach. Both sides continue to blame each other for the collapse of the trade agreement.

items.title: 大立光、雙鴻等4檔飆股明起遭關禁閉 3檔處置至9/9、聯鈞至9/11
items.title_en: Largan Precision, Shuanghong and Three Other Stocks Face Trading Suspensions Starting Tomorrow; Three Halted Until Sep 9, Lianjun Until Sep 11
paras: 證交所及櫃買中心今(2)日公告新增處置股，包括股價超過千金的光學股大立光(3008-TW)、散熱股雙鴻(3324-TW)以及光通訊股聯鈞(3450-TW)及前鼎(4908-TW)，處置時間從明(3)日起開始，除了聯鈞處置期至9月11日共7日之外，其餘3檔將關至9月9月，分盤交易均為2分鐘撮合一次。
處置原因部分，大立光為最近6個營業日累積收盤價漲幅達32.45%，且6個營業日起迄2個營業日收盤價價差達1,520元。最近90個營業日起迄2個營業日之收盤價漲幅達200.24%。
聯鈞處置原因為9月2日之本益比為122.11，且股價淨值比為15.7。另當日周轉率為7.56%，暨美商高盛證券商成交買進金額達新台幣1億元以上，且占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率為11.89%。單一投資人當日買進該有價證券之成交金額占當日該有價證券總成交金額比率10%以上，且達新台幣1億元以上。
雙鴻為最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.08%，且當日周轉率達11.82%。
前鼎最近6個營業日累積之最後成交價漲幅達31.68%，且當日之成交量較最近60個營業日日平均成交量放大6.6倍，且當日周轉率達22.44%。
大立光近期股價持續狂飆，今日在外資由賣轉買助攻下大漲3.03％，昨(1)日盤中更一度衝上7,995元寫新天價。
paras_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced today (the 2nd) the addition of four stocks to the special handling list: optical giant Largan Precision (3008‑TW), cooling specialist Shuanghong (3324‑TW), optical‑communication firm Lianjun (3450‑TW) and QianDing (4908‑TW). The handling period begins tomorrow (the 3rd). Except for Lianjun, which will be restricted for seven days until September 11, the other three will be suspended until September 9, with each trading session limited to a 2‑minute matching interval.

The reason for Largan Precision’s handling is that over the past six trading days its closing price rose cumulatively by 32.45%, and the price difference between the closing price six days ago and two days ago reached NT$1,520. Over the past 90 trading days, the cumulative closing‑price increase over the last two days was 200.24%.

Lianjun is being handled because its price‑to‑earnings ratio on September 2 was 122.11 and its price‑to‑book ratio was 15.7. That day its turnover rate was 7.56%, and Goldman Sachs (U.S.) bought more than NT$100 million of the stock, accounting for 11.89% of the total value‑traded securities that day. A single investor’s purchases also exceeded NT$100 million and represented over 10% of the day’s total securities turnover.
Shuanghong’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.08% based on the last transaction price, and its turnover rate on the day was 11.82%.

QianDing’s cumulative price increase over the past six trading days reached 31.68% based on the last transaction price, and its trading volume that day was 6.6 times the average volume of the previous 60 trading days, with a turnover rate of 22.44%.

Largan Precision’s stock has been soaring recently; today it jumped 3.03% aided by foreign investors switching from selling to buying. Yesterday (the 1st) it even surged to NT$7,995 intraday, setting a new all‑time high.

items.title: AOI設備廠牧德8月營收3.61億元續創新高年增35.68%
items.title_en: AOI Equipment Maker Mude Technology's August Revenue Hits NT$361 Million, Continuing Record High with 35.68% YoY Growth
paras: AOI設備廠牧德科技(3563-TW)今(2)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收3.61億元，續創新高，月增約0.42 %、年增約 35.68 %，累計2026年1-8月營收26.31億元，年增14.39%。牧德指出，公司營運動能穩定成長中 ，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季。
牧德表示，隨 AI 基礎建設持續擴大，電子產品朝高效能、高密度及高階化發展，帶動相關製程對精密檢測設備需求提升。牧德持續聚焦高階應用市場，未來產品布局以AI 伺服器 GPU 應用、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝為主要發展方向，透過檢測技術與產品持續升級，掌握 AI 產業鏈及高階電子製程所衍生的檢測需求。
牧德並指出，光模組 MSA 及高階載板相關應用，隨 AI 伺服器、高速交換器及高速 傳輸需求成長，對線路精度、微細化及產品可靠度要求持續提高，帶動 MSAP 及高階載板製程相關檢測需求。公司將持續強化相關檢測技術與產品開發，提升高階應用市場布局，並積極掌握新世代電子產品製程升級所帶來的市場機會。
牧德的整體接單能見度維持良好水準，部分高階產品接單已延伸至未來數季，市場需求也優於去年同期。隨 AI 伺服器 GPU 、光模組 MSA 、高階載板及先進封裝等應用同步持續發展，加上新產品陸續導入，相關市場需求可望逐步反映於公司營運動能發展。
AOI 設備廠牧德科技 2026 年第二季營收 10.47 億元，毛利率 60.41%，季減 0.17 個百分點，年減 3.82 個百分點，稅後純益 3.32 億元，季增 12.65%，年增 36.15%，每股純益 5.19 元，
牧德科技 2026 年上半年營收 19.11 億元，毛利率 60.49%，年減 3.79 個百分點，2026 年上半年稅後純益 6.27 億元，年增 14.5%，每股純益 9.8 元。
paras_en: Mude Technology (3563‑TW) announced today that its August 2026 revenue reached NT$3.61 billion, setting a new high. The month‑over‑month increase was about 0.42% and the year‑over‑year rise about 35.68%. Cumulative revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$26.31 billion, up 14.39% YoY. Mude said its operating momentum remains stable, with some high‑end product orders already extending into the coming quarters.

Mude noted that as AI infrastructure continues to expand, electronic products are moving toward higher performance, higher density and more advanced designs, driving greater demand for precision inspection equipment in related processes. The company will keep focusing on the high‑end application market, with future product roadmaps centered on AI server GPU applications, optical module MSA, advanced substrates and advanced packaging. By continuously upgrading inspection technologies and products, Mude aims to capture the testing needs generated by the AI supply chain and high‑end electronic processes.

Mude also pointed out that applications for optical‑module MSA and advanced substrates are growing alongside AI servers, high‑speed switches and high‑speed transmission requirements. This raises demands for line accuracy, miniaturization and product reliability, boosting testing needs for MSAP and advanced‑substrate processes. The company will keep strengthening related inspection technologies and product development, enhance its high‑end market positioning, and actively seize market opportunities created by next‑generation electronic product process upgrades.

Overall order visibility for Mude remains strong, with some high‑end product orders already extending into several future quarters, and market demand exceeding that of the same period last year. As AI‑server GPU, optical‑module MSA, advanced substrate and advanced packaging applications continue to develop, and new products are gradually introduced, related market demand is expected to be reflected progressively in the company’s operating momentum.

Mude Technology reported Q2 2026 revenue of NT$1.047 billion, a gross margin of 60.41% (down 0.17 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, down 3.82 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$332 million, up 12.65% quarter‑over‑quarter and 36.15% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$5.19.

For the first half of 2026, Mude posted revenue of NT$1.911 billion, a gross margin of 60.49% (down 3.79 points YoY), net profit after tax of NT$627 million, up 14.5% YoY, and earnings per share of NT$9.80.

items.title: 市場震盪避風港！遠銀Bankee首創「靈活存」 活存2.435%罕見超越定存
items.title_en: Safe Haven Amid Market Turbulence: Bankee Introduces First‑Ever "Flexible Deposit" with 2.435% Current‑Account Rate Exceeding Fixed Deposit
paras: 面對全球市場震盪，不少投資人選擇暫時退守現金，卻常陷於「定存怕綁死、活存利息低」的兩難。遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行推出業界首創的「靈活存」專案，打破市場既定印象，首度將「定存與活存款項納入同一套資金配置」，更祭出活存年利率 2.435% 反超定存利率的罕見優惠，宣告正式打響數位銀行資金搶奪戰。
傳統理財觀念中，資金流動性與高收益往往不可兼得。遠東商銀 Bankee 表示，觀察到許多持有觀望資金或備用金的客戶，普遍存在「想爭取高收益，又不願犧牲調度彈性」的痛點。「靈活存」專案即是從該痛點出發，透過新機制將收益與流動性整合，創造定存與活存相互加乘的效益。
本次專案最大亮點，在於顛覆市場常規的「逆向利率操作」。民眾只要以符合條件之新資金開立一年期、固定年利率 1.78% 的定存，即可同步取得定存本金 50% 的高利活存額度，享受高達 2.435% 的活存年利率。專案門檻極具親民度，單筆最低 1 萬元即可起存，最高可達 300 萬元且不限筆數，不論是小資族或高資產客群皆能彈性參與。
以投入 100 萬元資金為例，開立一年期「靈活存」後，除 100 萬元可享固定年利率 1.78% 的定存收益外，還能額外取得最高 50 萬元的 2.435% 高利活存額度。最特別的是，該筆高利活存額度「不需一次存滿」，客戶可先鎖定高利率額度，再依據自身資金調度需求隨時存入或提領。
遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行強調，理財工具應隨市場環境與人生階段動態調整。在市場變動加劇的時代，資金主導權應回歸消費者身上。「靈活存」將單一利率選擇轉化為高彈性的資金調度工具，讓民眾在等待下一個最佳投資時機前，既能賺取高於一般定存的收益，又能保有「隨時拔槍進場」的機動性，實現資金效益最大化。
paras_en: Facing global market turbulence, many investors temporarily retreat to cash, yet often find themselves caught between the dilemma of "fixed deposits feel locked in" and "current accounts offer low interest." Bankee, a community bank of Far East Commercial Bank, has launched the industry’s first "Flexible Deposit" program, breaking the market’s conventional perception by incorporating both fixed and current deposits into a single funding strategy and offering a rare 2.435% annual rate on current deposits that surpasses the fixed deposit rate, officially launching a digital banking funding war.

In traditional financial thinking, liquidity and high returns are often seen as mutually exclusive. Bankee observed that many customers holding speculative or reserve funds generally face the pain point of wanting higher returns without sacrificing scheduling flexibility. The "Flexible Deposit" project addresses this pain point by integrating returns and liquidity through a new mechanism, creating a synergistic benefit between fixed and current deposits.

The highlight of this project lies in its reverse‑rate operation that overturns market norms. Customers who open a one‑year fixed deposit at a qualifying rate of 1.78% automatically receive a high‑interest current deposit credit equal to 50% of the fixed deposit principal, enjoying an annual rate of up to 2.435%. The program’s threshold is highly accessible: a minimum single deposit of 10,000 yuan is required, with a maximum of 3,000,000 yuan and no limit on the number of deposits, allowing both low‑income and high‑net‑worth customers to participate flexibly.

For example, with an investment of 1,000,000 yuan, opening a one‑year "Flexible Deposit" yields a fixed deposit return at 1.78% and an additional high‑interest current deposit credit of up to 500,000 yuan at 2.435%. The special feature of this high‑interest current deposit credit is that it does not need to be deposited in full at once; customers can lock in the high rate and then deposit or withdraw funds at any time according to their liquidity needs.

Bankee emphasizes that financial tools should dynamically adjust to market conditions and life stages. In an era of heightened market volatility, control of funds should return to consumers. "Flexible Deposit" transforms a single rate choice into a highly flexible funding tool, allowing people to earn returns higher than typical fixed deposits while retaining the ability to "jump in at any time," maximizing the efficiency of their capital before the next optimal investment opportunity arises.

items.title: 無懼大盤回檔！00406A除息逆勢吸金 掩護性買權策略發揮優勢
paras: 中東地緣政治衝突再度升溫，受美股重挫拖累，台股今(2)日開低走低，終場大跌784點，收在46164.72點，跌幅1.67%，成交金額縮減至不到兆元。ETF 方面，市場交投熱絡，單日成交量突破20萬張的焦點包含群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)與主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)。其中，00406A 逢除息首日，在大盤重挫之際展現強勁抗震力，吸引買盤逆勢低接，也顯見當市場波動度放大時，反而能為掩護性買權(Covered Call)策略創造出更高的權利金收益空間，吸引資金進場布局。
法人表示，隨著地緣政治風險升溫、美債殖利率攀高，以及美股回檔等因素影響，電子權值股遭獲利了結賣壓衝擊，台積電更失守2400元整數關卡，AI伺服器、高階PCB及記憶體等族群全面走弱。不過市場資金並未完全撤出，部分轉向受惠國際油價上漲的塑化、化工及能源概念股，使其成為今日盤面少數亮點。
主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)今(2)日除息，在大盤重挫之際仍吸引買盤低接，成交量維持高檔。投資專家表示，短線盤勢仍將處於震盪加劇階段，而投資組合若建立掩護性買權(Covered Call)部位，將有機會收取更高的權利金收入。尤其近期市場呈現高檔震盪、區間整理，甚至漲一天跌一天的格局，正是權利金策略相對有利的操作環境。
對於00406A這類透過權利金創造現金流的產品而言，近期盤勢反而具有正面助益。由於市場波動放大，有利於提升權利金收入來源。同時，市場普遍認為AI資本支出成長趨勢未變，即使短線出現如今日的大幅震盪，長期最受惠的仍是00406A所持有的核心科技股；而波動率上升同步提高權利金收益，也有助於強化整體收益表現。
主動中信台灣收益ETF經理人張書廷表示，後續仍可持續觀察SEMICON Taiwan展會效應、AI供應鏈接單狀況等。儘管大盤短期內可能維持震盪整理格局，但半導體、AI伺服器、先進封裝、電力與散熱，以及高速傳輸等長線主流趨勢並未改變。

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉鴻海劉揚偉：MIT思維應轉向「Made with Taiwan」 與全球市場共同製造
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉今(2)日出席半導體展大師論壇表示，全球供應鏈正在改變，台灣企業過去強調「Made in Taiwan台灣製造」的思維也必須轉變，未來應思考與市場所在國家「Made with Taiwan與台灣共同製造」。
劉揚偉指出，大約10年前就已觀察到全球供應鏈將發生改變，隨著地緣政治情勢發展，這項趨勢變得進一步加速且更具挑戰，但這其實是非常自然的發展，因為各國領導人都在尋求經濟成長與國家繁榮，也會思考如何增加當地GDP，以及為什麼當地消費的產品不能在自己的國家製造。
而對客戶來說，要的是「去風險化(De-risking)」而非「脫鉤(Decoupling)」，因此，台灣企業必須走出台灣、前往其他國家，不僅是為了滿足客戶需求，也是為了滿足消費該產品國家的需求。
劉揚偉表示，台灣擁有獨特文化、良好教育體系及穩定的政府政策，因此非常擅長做兼具「品質」與「速度」的事情，面對需求快速且龐大的情況，台灣的文化與環境適合快速適應、迅速行動。
他也引用自己在2022年在印尼舉行的B20峰會上提出的「Share, collaborate, and thrive together(分享、合作，並共同繁榮）」的概念，過去是在同一個國家完成所有事情，未來則應與其他國家分享、合作，進而共同繁榮。
劉揚偉強調，台灣過去總認為必須是「Made in Taiwan」，但從現在開始，應思考如何做到「Made with Taiwan」，與市場所在國家共同製造，如果台灣行動夠快，同時將部分生產轉移到產品將被使用的國家，雙方結合在一起，就能共同繁榮，而不僅僅是單一國家受益。

items.title: Fed鷹派聲浪踩煞車！威廉斯：升息理由還不夠
items.title_en: Fed Hawkish Tone Hits the Brakes! Williams: Not Enough Reason to Raise Rates
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周三(2日)表示，近期通膨數據令人鼓舞，隨著關稅造成的一次性價格衝擊逐漸消退，通膨正緩慢下降，目前尚無明確證據顯示Fed必須再次升息。
威廉斯接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，目前推升物價的主要因素仍是關稅，以及中東衝突造成的能源價格上漲，部分服務業通膨也依然偏高。不過，能源成本上升尚未擴散至其他服務項目，Fed也未觀察到關稅引發第二輪通膨效應，通膨預期仍受到控制。
威廉斯說：「最近的數據令人鼓舞。」隨著部分關稅影響逐漸成為過去，通膨趨勢正緩慢下滑，但目前仍無法確定現行貨幣政策是否足以確保未來一至兩年內讓通膨回到目標，或Fed是否必須採取進一步行動。
威廉斯支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月維持利率不變的決定，並認為目前利率處於適當位置，足以平衡充分就業與物價穩定的雙重使命。不過，他強調Fed仍在蒐集大量數據，之後必須重新評估政策立場。
Fed將於9月15日至16日在華盛頓召開利率會議，此前今年已連續5次按兵不動。7月會議有3名具投票權的官員主張升息1碼，顯示決策官員對政策限制程度看法不一。期貨市場一度反映，Fed本月將利率提高1碼至3.75%至4%的機率約達三分之二，但威廉斯的談話顯示，升息仍非板上釘釘。
身為Fed決策核心人物，威廉斯的立場通常代表政策辯論中的中間派看法。Fed在會議前還將取得一份最新通膨報告，市場也將關注Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(3日)的談話。
對於近期長期公債殖利率上升，威廉斯認為，主要反映美國經濟與成長前景強勁，以及AI、資料中心和科技領域的龐大投資需求，而非通膨失控或市場出現信用疑慮。
他表示，若未來出現持續性的生產力繁榮，確實可能推升不刺激也不抑制經濟的中性利率，但目前尚未看到足夠證據。威廉斯估計中性利率約為1%，實質利率雖略有上升，幅度仍相當有限。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair and New York Fed President John Williams said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that recent inflation data are encouraging, and as the one‑off price shock from tariffs fades, inflation is slowly easing, with no clear evidence that the Fed needs to raise rates again.

In an interview with CNBC, Williams noted that the main drivers of price pressures remain tariffs and higher energy prices due to the Middle‑East conflict, and some services inflation remains elevated. However, the rise in energy costs has not yet spread to other services, the Fed has not seen a second‑round inflation effect from tariffs, and inflation expectations remain under control.

Williams said, “The recent data are encouraging.” As the impact of some tariffs recedes, the inflation trend is gradually sliding down, but it is still uncertain whether the current monetary policy is sufficient to bring inflation back to target over the next one to two years, or whether the Fed must take further action.

Williams supported the Federal Open Market Committee’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and said the current rate level is appropriate to balance the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. He emphasized, however, that the Fed is still gathering a large amount of data and will have to reassess its policy stance later.

The Fed will hold its rate‑policy meeting in Washington on September 15‑16, after five consecutive pauses this year. At the July meeting, three voting members advocated a one‑basis‑point hike, showing differing views among policymakers on how restrictive policy should be. Futures once priced a roughly two‑thirds chance that the Fed would raise rates by one basis point to 3.75%‑4% this month, but Williams’s comments suggest a hike is not a foregone conclusion.

As a core member of the Fed’s decision‑making team, Williams’s stance usually reflects a centrist view in policy debates. The Fed will also receive a fresh inflation report before the meeting, and markets will watch Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Thursday (the 3rd).

Regarding the recent rise in long‑term Treasury yields, Williams said it mainly reflects a strong U.S. economy and growth outlook, as well as massive investment demand in AI, data centers and the tech sector, rather than runaway inflation or credit concerns in the market.

He added that if a sustained productivity boom materializes, it could indeed push the neutral rate higher—neither stimulating nor restraining the economy—but there is not enough evidence yet. Williams estimates the neutral rate at about 1%, and while real rates have risen slightly, the increase remains modest.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價回落抵消美債殖利率壓力 主要指數變動不大
paras: 美股主要指數周三(2日)開盤變動不大，油價自高檔回落，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，但美債殖利率仍處於多年高點，持續壓抑投資人風險偏好。
西德州中級原油跌破每桶90美元，中止因美伊爭奪荷姆茲海峽控制權而引發的連兩日漲勢；美國10年期公債殖利率在觸及兩年高點後大致持平。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近260點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近20點或0.07%，標普 500 指數漲近0.1%，費城半導體指數跌近0.1%。台積電 ADR 漲近0.3%。
國際油價中止連日漲勢，稍微緩解市場對能源成本推升通膨的擔憂，美股期指周三(2日)盤前收斂跌幅，美國公券價格同步走高。不過，全球公債殖利率仍上升壓力，加上主要央行可能在本月升息，市場情緒依然謹慎。
截稿前，標普500指數期貨大致持平。戴爾科技(DELL-US)受強勁營收預測激勵，盤前股價上漲。歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.3%，亞洲股市創兩周來最大跌幅，美元變動不大。
布蘭特原油在連續兩個交易日上漲後回落至每桶94美元附近。美國公債逆勢上揚，30年期美債殖利率下跌2個基點至5.25%，但其他多數市場的債券價格仍然走低。周三公布的ADP數據顯示，美國8月民間就業人口增加3.8萬人，低於預期，反映勞動市場招聘動能放緩。
油價回落暫時減輕市場壓力。此前能源價格持續上漲，加深投資人對通膨再度升溫的憂慮，也使原本已受到政府大舉舉債及企業融資需求壓迫的債市進一步走弱。
交易員目前預估，包括聯準會(Fed)在內的三家主要央行，本月升息機率均已超過50%，其中Fed升息機率約為65%。ING策略師Chris Turner指出，市場新的基本假設似乎已轉為Fed終究會在9月升息。Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)已清楚表明，通膨下降速度仍不足以回到目標，加上經濟維持一定韌性，Fed可能必須採取行動。
儘管全球債市承受賣壓，但殖利率升幅相對溫和，仍為交易員帶來些許安慰。法國巴黎銀行財富管理策略師Stephan Kemper表示，本輪債市下跌有秩序且範圍廣泛，並非由信用風險或流動性壓力引發，顯示市場正在反映利率將在更長時間維持高檔，而不是預示信用危機或經濟衰退。
Kemper認為，殖利率能否回落的關鍵仍在通膨預期。如果長天期殖利率壓力獲得緩解，考量企業基本面依然強勁，股市可能出現大幅上漲。企業現金部位在AI支出激增之際仍重返歷史高點，也為股市提供支撐。今年全球股票市場已吸引約1.1兆美元資金，創2021年以來最大流入。
不過，Global Gate Asset Management策略師Patrik Lang警告，一旦美國與日本公債殖利率突破目前阻力區，股市韌性可能受到考驗。目前投資人部位偏高，短期指標也進入超買區，無論基本面如何，未來數周市場均可能進入整理。

items.title: 美國企業內部人加碼自家公司廢棄物處理龍頭Republic Services獲逾1.2億美元買盤
items.title_en: U.S. corporate insiders increase stakes in waste‑management leader Republic Services with over $120 million in purchases
paras: 2026年09月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國企業內部人近期持續買進自家公司股票。根據向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)申報的資料，其中以美國廢棄物管理與環境服務龍頭Republic Services(RSG-US)相關持股增加規模最受矚目。
Republic Services主要從事垃圾收集、回收、轉運與掩埋場處理，並提供危險及工業廢棄物處理服務，與Waste Management(WM-US)並列美國廢棄物管理產業兩大業者。Cascade Investment於8月26日至27日買進Republic Services共560,100股，平均價格約220.52美元，換算交易金額約1.24億美元。
其他較大筆交易包括Optimum Communications(OPTU-US)主要股東於7月29日至8月25日累計買進3,032,354股，平均價格0.81美元，交易金額約246萬美元；Suja Life(SUJA-US)主要股東則於8月26日至28日買進652,248股，平均價格9.35美元，交易金額約610萬美元。
個別公司管理階層也有加碼。Matador Resources(MTDR-US)財務長買進2,500股、每股56.64美元；Pulse Biosciences(PLSE-US)營運長則買進2,070股、每股48.29美元。
內部人買進通常被市場視為管理階層或主要股東對公司價值的信心訊號，但單筆交易仍需搭配買進者身分、既有持股、公司基本面及交易是否屬固定投資計畫判斷，不能單獨視為股價上漲訊號。

paras_en: September 2, 2026 (U‑Analysis/Industry Data Center) — U.S. corporate insiders have been buying more of their own companies' stock recently. According to filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the most notable increase involves Republic Services (RSG‑US), the leading waste‑management and environmental services company.

Republic Services primarily handles garbage collection, recycling, transfer and landfill operations, and provides hazardous and industrial waste treatment services, ranking alongside Waste Management (WM‑US) as the two biggest players in the U.S. waste‑management sector. Cascade Investment purchased a total of 560,100 shares of Republic Services on August 26‑27 at an average price of about $220.52 per share, amounting to roughly $124 million.

Other sizable transactions include the principal shareholder of Optimum Communications (OPTU‑US), who bought a cumulative 3,032,354 shares between July 29 and August 25 at an average price of $0.81, for about $2.46 million, and the principal shareholder of Suja Life (SUJA‑US), who bought 652,248 shares from August 26‑28 at an average price of $9.35, for roughly $6.10 million.

Management of individual companies also increased their holdings. The chief financial officer of Matador Resources (MTDR‑US) bought 2,500 shares at $56.64 each, and the chief operating officer of Pulse Biosciences (PLSE‑US) purchased 2,070 shares at $48.29 each.

Insider purchases are often viewed by the market as a confidence signal from management or major shareholders about a company's value, but each transaction must be evaluated in the context of the buyer’s identity, existing holdings, the company’s fundamentals, and whether the trade is part of a regular investment plan; it should not be taken as a standalone indicator of a price rise.

items.title: Cerebras芬蘭擴建AI資料中心｜簽下165MW長約首期50MW已動工
items.title_en: Cerebras Expands AI Data Center in Finland, Signs 165MW Contract with First 50MW Under Construction
paras: 2026年09月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片業者Cerebras Systems(CBRS-US)宣布與Compute Nordic Finland合作，在芬蘭Mikkeli興建大型AI資料中心，規劃IT容量最高達165MW，首期50MW已開始施工，後續將分階段擴至80MW及165MW。
值得注意的是，這項計畫並非單純先蓋再找需求。雙方已透過一系列服務訂單簽訂7年期合約，代表部分AI算力需求已轉化為長期承諾，也讓Cerebras取得支撐全球AI運算服務擴張所需的資料中心容量。
隨AI資料中心功率密度持續提高，電力與冷卻已成為擴張關鍵。Mikkeli資料中心將採用封閉循環冷卻系統，降低持續取用市政用水的需求，並規劃回收AI運算產生的廢熱。Cerebras表示，目標是在每MW電力下提高可產出的有效AI算力。
根據Ramboll研究估算，若最終擴建至165MW，整體投資規模約10~17億歐元。

paras_en: On September 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI chip maker Cerebras Systems (CBRS-US) announced a partnership with Compute Nordic Finland to build a large AI data center in Mikkeli, Finland, planning a maximum IT capacity of 165 MW, with the first phase of 50 MW already under construction and later phases to expand to 80 MW and ultimately 165 MW.

It is noteworthy that this project is not simply built first and then find demand. The two parties have already signed a series of service orders covering a seven‑year contract, meaning that part of the AI compute demand has been converted into a long‑term commitment, giving Cerebras the data‑center capacity needed to support the expansion of its global AI computing services.

As AI data‑center power density continues to rise, power and cooling become critical to expansion. The Mikkeli data center will use a closed‑loop cooling system to reduce continuous municipal water usage and will plan to recycle waste heat generated by AI computing. Cerebras says its goal is to increase the effective AI compute output per megawatt of power.
According to a Ramboll study, if the expansion reaches the full 165 MW, the total investment is estimated at roughly €1.0‑1.7 billion.

items.title: 波克夏為何狂買Alphabet？阿貝爾親揭關鍵原因
items.title_en: Why Berkshire Is Buying Alphabet in a Frenzy? Abel Reveals the Key Reason
paras: 波克夏海瑟威(BRK.A-US)(BRK.B-US)執行長阿貝爾(Greg Abel)周三(2日)表示，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)是人工智慧(AI)領域的「重要參與者」。波克夏第二季大舉加碼Alphabet，使其一躍成為公司股票投資組合的第三大持股。
阿貝爾接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，波克夏可從旗下企業實際運用AI的情況，清楚掌握這項技術帶來的影響及效益，因而進一步提高投資興趣，同時看好Google在AI競賽中的強勢地位。
阿貝爾透露，波克夏15個月前以折價6.5%的條件，取得價值100億美元的Google持股。當時交易規模尚未確定，但對方建議波克夏考慮投入100億美元，阿貝爾隨後與巴菲特(Warren Buffett)討論投資金額及折價幅度，最終完成交易。
根據波克夏8月向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的第二季持股資料，公司當季增持總值約170億美元的Alphabet股票，成為該季最大規模的新增投資。截至最新申報，波克夏持有約1.06億股Alphabet A類與C類股票，按目前市價計算，價值約366億美元。
除Alphabet外，波克夏第二季也大舉加碼達美航空(DAL-US)，持股規模增加44%，增持價值約16億美元。不過Alphabet在波克夏投資組合中的地位明顯提升，凸顯阿貝爾與巴菲特對其AI發展潛力的信心。
Google與微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta(META-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)並列五大超大規模雲端服務業者，正投入鉅額資本支出，擴充運行AI所需的資料中心與運算能力。
高盛(GS-US)估計，2026年全球超大規模雲端業者資本支出可能接近1兆美元，但各機構預測差異相當大。高盛研究人員指出，市場普遍引用的7,940億美元預測，可能低估全球AI資本支出約2,000億美元，卻也可能高估美國境內AI投資相同金額。
對投資人而言，關鍵仍是這些龐大支出何時能轉化為回報。高盛警告，若AI運算需求持續由模型訓練主導，企業在廣泛商業化之前仍須不斷投入資本支出與研發經費，投資報酬實現的時間可能進一步延後。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US)(BRK.B-US) CEO Greg Abel told CNBC on Wednesday (Feb. 2) that Alphabet (GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US), Google’s parent company, is a "key player" in the AI arena. Berkshire’s second‑quarter investment in Alphabet surged, making it the company’s third‑largest holding in its equity portfolio.

Abel said Berkshire can clearly see the impact and benefits of AI through its subsidiaries’ actual use of the technology, which has further increased its investment interest and confidence in Google’s strong position in the AI race.

Abel revealed that Berkshire acquired $10 billion of Google shares 15 months ago at a 6.5% discount. At the time the transaction size was not yet determined, but the counterparty suggested Berkshire consider investing $10 billion. Abel then discussed the investment amount and discount with Warren Buffett, and the deal was ultimately completed.

According to Berkshire’s second‑quarter holdings filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in August, the company increased its Alphabet stake by about $17 billion, the largest new investment of the quarter. As of the latest filing, Berkshire holds roughly 106 million shares of Alphabet Class A and C, valued at about $36.6 billion at current prices.

In addition to Alphabet, Berkshire also significantly increased its stake in Delta Air Lines (DAL-US) in the second quarter, raising its holdings by 44% and adding about $1.6 billion. However, Alphabet’s prominence in Berkshire’s portfolio has clearly risen, underscoring Abel’s and Buffett’s confidence in its AI growth potential.

Google, Microsoft (MSFT-US), Meta (META-US), Amazon (AMZN-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US) are the five largest hyperscale cloud providers, all investing heavily in capital expenditures to expand the data centers and computing power needed to run AI.

Goldman Sachs (GS-US) estimates that global hyperscale cloud spend could approach $1 trillion in 2026, but forecasts vary widely. Goldman research notes that the commonly cited $794 billion figure may underestimate global AI capital spend by about $200 billion, while possibly overestimating U.S.‑based AI investment by the same amount.

For investors, the key question remains when these massive expenditures will translate into returns. Goldman warns that if AI compute demand continues to be dominated by model training, companies will need to keep investing in capital and R&D before widespread commercialization, potentially delaying the realization of investment returns.

items.title: 債市殖利率飆高對股市是「好事」？小摩：反映經濟強勁
paras: 全球債券市場殖利率近期持續攀升，日本、德國與英國10年期公債殖利率分別升至30年、15年及18年來高點。不過，市場並非一致認為利率走高將對股市構成壓力，部分經濟學家與投資策略師反而認為，殖利率上升反映經濟成長動能強勁，未必是股市的壞消息。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，經濟學家Matthew C. Klein週二（1日）在Substack發表一篇文章，主張「債券殖利率上升其實是好事」，因為這反映出強勁的經濟成長。目前收入與支出年增率達7%，資本需求也十分強勁，尤其是在AI基礎設施持續擴建的情況下。
他同時指出，這也是2008年全球金融危機後、長期失衡的低利率時代逐步回歸正常的過程。Klein認為：「太多人把低利率視為正常現象，這其實是深層社會病態的症狀。」
他也指出，雖然許多評論人士將債券殖利率上升歸因於不可持續的財政赤字，但「截至目前，美國經濟數據完全沒有顯示經濟即將放緩的跡象」。
事實上，Klein認為，在聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）上週五發表鷹派言論後，市場目前對聯準會9月升息可能性的預期升高，這「大致上仍是好消息」。
他還認為，與過去相比，美國消費支出及企業投資對信貸條件的敏感度都已明顯下降。
摩根大通策略師Mislav Matejka週二公布下半年展望時，同樣對債券殖利率走高抱持相對淡定的態度。他表示，目前沒有理由認為殖利率上升將成為股市無法克服的障礙，因為利率攀升反映的是經濟活動動能更加強勁。
全球股市進一步上漲的動力包括企業獲利表現強勁、每股盈餘（EPS）預估持續上修、各國央行最終採取的緊縮措施可能低於投資人目前的擔憂，且採購經理人指數（PMI）的反彈，亦顯示經濟活動動能正在增強。
Matejka指出，歐洲PMI修正值已連續3個月上升，進一步強化他對歐洲股市及國際股市的投資論點。如果美元指數見頂，也將為歐洲及國際股市提供額外支撐。
至於美元走勢，Matejka認為市場對升息的預期已相當鷹派，進一步轉向更鷹派的空間有限。因此，儘管自荷姆茲海峽危機爆發以來，美元一度扮演某種避險資產角色，但後續美元可能重新走弱。
這項變化也可能為近期大幅回落的黃金帶來支撐。自中東爆發戰事以來，金價已下跌約20%至25%。
Matejka預期金價將反彈，並認為市場可能重新關注所謂的「貶值交易」，也就是在法定貨幣價值面臨下滑時，偏好具抗通膨及避險特性的實體資產。
有利於國際股市的另一項因素是估值。Matejka認為，美股目前約為未來盈餘的20倍，估值已顯得「偏高」，但國際股市及新興市場的估值相對便宜。
MSCI全球全市場指數在2025年已較美股領先15個百分點，今年以來也領先約4%，該報告預期這項趨勢將持續。摩根大通給予標普500指數年底目標價8,000點，較目前水準高出約3%。
Matejka維持加碼新興市場、減碼已開發市場的投資建議，並點名記憶體產業趨勢趨於穩定，以及中國經濟復甦，可能成為推動新興市場進一步上漲的潛在因素。

items.title: 不只賣晶片 黃仁動的更大野心：讓輝達架構「全球AI工廠」新藍圖
items.title_en: Beyond Selling Chips: Jensen Huang’s Bigger Ambition—Building a Global AI Factory Blueprint
paras: 在全球人工智慧浪潮中，輝達(NVDA-US)長期以提供高價值硬體晶片稱霸市場。然而，隨著各大科技巨頭紛紛投入開發客製化 AI 晶片，輝達面臨的競爭壓力也與日俱增。對此，雅虎財經全球市場與數據編輯Jared Blikre分析認為：「客製化 AI 晶片是威脅輝達主導地位的最大隱憂之一，而執行長黃仁勳的應對之道，則是無論如何都要從中獲利。」
Blikre表示，輝達的長遠核心計畫，是讓自己轉型為「AI 的架構定義者」，而非僅僅是一個晶片製造商。

引進客製化晶片 擴大資料中心架構

輝達本周宣布向台灣晶片設計大廠聯發科(2454-TW)投資 35 億美元。此項合作旨在協助客戶開發能與輝達更廣泛系統串聯的客製化 AI 晶片。透過輝達於 2025 年 5 月推出的「NVLink Fusion」技術，客戶即便自行開發能與輝達 GPU 競爭的晶片，依然能將其深度整合至輝達的資料中心架構中。
這意味著即便輝達在單一晶片銷售上讓步，仍能保留整套基礎設施的銷售商機。例如，亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)雖計畫導入 200 萬顆輝達 GPU，同時也將其自研的 Trainium AI 晶片更深地接入輝達的架構中。

「AI 工廠」的代幣輸出與營收翻倍

黃仁勳近期對此架構轉型做出了生動的詮釋：「輸入的是電子，輸出的是 Tokens(代幣)。」
輝達已將其業務模式從單純銷售 GPU，轉向整座「AI 工廠」的系統化輸出。在最近的財報會議中，輝達透露，其在每吉瓦(GW)電力容量下的營收機會正呈現爆發式成長：從 Hopper 世代的 180 億美元，攀升至 Grace Blackwell 世代的 250 億美元，而在最新的「Vera Rubin」架構下，預期將達到 400 億美元。
Blikre分析，Vera Rubin 不僅是新一代 GPU，它更融合了輝達最新的 CPU、GPU、網路、記憶體以及周邊基礎設施，這種藉由銷售整座 AI 工廠周邊配備的策略，正是其營收增長的主因。

聯手華爾街 解決「資金瓶頸」

隨著 AI 發展的瓶頸從早期的晶片短缺、電力限制，逐步蔓延到資金不足，輝達正積極攜手華爾街來打破這項障礙。
輝達已聯手阿波羅(Apollo)、貝萊德(BlackRock)、黑石(Blackstone)、布魯克菲爾德(Brookfield)、高盛與 KKR 等金融巨頭，計畫動員超過 5,000 億美元的資金，將算力視為能對抗未來需求進行融資的基礎設施。
在此趨勢下，AI 新創公司 Anthropic 已承諾投入 350 億美元，向輝達支持的專業 AI 雲端服務商 Lambda 租用算力。
paras_en: In the global AI wave, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) has long dominated the market by offering high‑value hardware chips. However, as major tech giants increasingly invest in custom AI chips, NVIDIA faces mounting competitive pressure. Yahoo Finance global markets and data editor Jared Blikre notes that "custom AI chips are one of the biggest hidden threats to NVIDIA’s dominance, and CEO Jensen Huang’s response is to profit from them no matter what."
Blikre says NVIDIA’s long‑term core plan is to transform itself into the "architect of AI", not just a chip manufacturer.

NVIDIA announced this week an investment of $3.5 billion in Taiwan chip‑design giant MediaTek (2454‑TW). The partnership aims to help customers develop custom AI chips that can integrate more broadly with NVIDIA’s systems. Using NVIDIA’s NVLink Fusion technology, launched in May 2025, customers can even develop chips that compete with NVIDIA GPUs and still deeply integrate them into NVIDIA’s data‑center architecture.

This means that even if NVIDIA concedes on single‑chip sales, it can still retain the entire infrastructure sales opportunity. For example, Amazon Web Services (AWS) plans to deploy 2 million NVIDIA GPUs while also integrating its own Trainium AI chips more deeply into NVIDIA’s architecture.
Jensen Huang recently illustrated this architectural shift by saying, "We input electronics, we output Tokens."

NVIDIA has shifted its business model from simply selling GPUs to delivering a fully integrated "AI factory". In a recent earnings call, NVIDIA disclosed that its revenue opportunity per gigawatt (GW) of power capacity is exploding: from $18 billion for the Hopper generation to $25 billion for the Grace‑Blackwell generation, and with the latest Vera Rubin architecture, it is expected to reach $40 billion.

Blikre analyzes that Vera Rubin is not just a new GPU generation; it also integrates NVIDIA’s latest CPU, GPU, networking, memory, and peripheral infrastructure. Selling the entire AI factory ecosystem is the main driver of its revenue growth.
As AI development bottlenecks shift from early chip shortages and power limits to funding shortages, NVIDIA is actively partnering with Wall Street to break this barrier.

NVIDIA has teamed with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR, planning to mobilize over $500 billion in capital, treating compute as an infrastructure that can finance future demand.
Against this backdrop, AI startup Anthropic has pledged to invest $35 billion, renting compute from Lambda, an AI cloud service provider backed by NVIDIA.

items.title: Google鎖定近1GW地熱電力｜AI資料中心搶電升級15年長約直接綁定新電廠
items.title_en: Google Locks in Nearly 1GW of Geothermal Power | AI Data Centers Upgrade Power Supply with 15-Year Contract Tied to New Plant
paras: 2026年09月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心愈蓋愈大，現在限制算力擴張的已不只是GPU夠不夠，而是有沒有足夠電力。Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與地熱能源業者Fervo Energy(FRVO-US)簽署15年購電協議(PPA)，初期鎖定396MW電力，供應規劃中的美國猶他州資料中心，並可再增加約600MW，最快2030年中將供電規模提高至接近1GW。
這批電力將來自Fervo位於猶他州Beaver County的Cape Station地熱發電計畫，目前首期100MW正在進行啟用作業。Google簽下長約後，Fervo將分4個99MW階段增加供電能力，並計畫在2028年底前將Cape Station整體規模擴大至約500MW。
更值得注意的是，Google希望降低對公用電網的依賴。規劃中的資料中心可透過「封閉式私人發電系統」取得電力，也就是讓大型用電戶更直接連結發電來源，減少等待電網擴建或排隊併網的時間。
這也反映AI資料中心的競爭正在從「搶GPU」延伸至「搶電」。當大型AI資料中心需要數百MW、甚至GW等級電力，光有晶片已經不夠，能不能提前鎖定穩定電源，開始直接決定新增算力何時能上線。
對能源產業而言，AI也正在創造新的投資模式。地熱可以24小時持續供電，較適合AI資料中心長時間運轉；Google這類大型科技公司再透過15年長約承諾買電，等於先提供長期需求，讓能源業者更有條件取得資金、興建新電廠。換句話說，AI資本支出正在從GPU、伺服器與資料中心，進一步往上游電力基礎建設延伸。

paras_en: AI data centers are expanding rapidly, and the limiting factor for computational growth is no longer just GPU availability but sufficient power supply. Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent company, has signed a 15‑year power purchase agreement (PPA) with geothermal energy developer Fervo Energy (FRVO-US), initially locking in 396 MW of electricity to supply a planned data center in Utah, with the option to add about 600 MW, potentially bringing the total to nearly 1 GW by mid‑2030.

The power will come from Fervo’s Cape Station geothermal project in Beaver County, Utah. The first phase of 100 MW is currently being commissioned. After signing the long‑term contract, Fervo will increase capacity in four 99 MW stages and plans to expand the entire Cape Station to roughly 500 MW by the end of 2028.

Notably, Google aims to reduce reliance on the public grid. The planned data center will use a “closed‑loop private power system,” allowing large‑scale users to connect directly to the power source, thereby shortening wait times for grid expansion or interconnection queues.

This reflects a shift in AI data center competition from “securing GPUs” to “securing power.” When large AI centers require hundreds of megawatts or even gigawatt‑scale electricity, having chips is no longer enough; the ability to lock in a stable supply in advance determines when additional compute can go online.

For the energy sector, AI is creating new investment models. Geothermal can provide continuous 24‑hour power, which is well suited for long‑running AI data centers. Large tech firms like Google, by committing to 15‑year PPA purchases, effectively provide long‑term demand, enabling energy developers to secure financing and build new plants. In other words, AI capital expenditure is extending from GPUs, servers, and data centers upstream into power infrastructure.

items.title: 債市風暴！全球長債「雪崩式」重定價：日債殖利率破3%創30年高 美債刺破4.8%
items.title_en: Bond Market Storm! Global Long‑Bond ‘Avalanche’ Repricing: Japan Yields Break 3% to 30‑Year High, US Yields Surge Past 4.8%
paras: 一場橫跨東京、法蘭克福、雪梨與紐約的同步拋售潮在周三(2日)席捲全球先進經濟體長債市場。日本10年期國債殖利率盤中突破3%，為1996年10月以來首見10年期美債衝上4.8%，創2025年1月來新高，30年期同步摸高5.28%；德國、澳洲10年期殖利率分別刷新15年與十餘年高點，彭博全球公債指數殖利率報3.72%，創2008年中以來最高。
專家指出，中東局勢推升油價造成通膨預期回歸，聯準會(Fed)主席華許在傑克森霍爾釋放鷹派訊號，CME FedWatch顯示9月升息機率由不足40%飆至近70%，巴克萊轉而預測9月、12月各升息1碼。
日本方面，美國財長貝森特在G20期間呼籲日本央行(BOJ)「進一步升息」，日本財務大臣片山皋月淡化貨幣政策討論，但市場認為BOJ本月升息概率已逼近99%，催動日債殖利率曲線陡峭化，10年期期限溢價達150基點，被安聯稱為「全球零成本資金時代終結的領先指標」。
匯率方面，日元在美日7月30日至8月26日豪擲15.3993兆日元(約965億美元)聯合干預後，仍貶回160附近，今年迄今干預規模27.13兆日元超過2003年，市場揣測東京恐被迫拋美債護盤。
更深層問題則是市場對財政信任打折。五礦證券尤春野指出，華許對通膨容忍度明顯下降，要求底層通膨「明確且快速」回2%；中金則認為「財政主導」下，Fedㄐㄧㄤ難置身事外。
當10年美債4.8%對應無風險收益，標普500滾動本益比26倍(盈利收益率僅3.7)，股債性價比落入負值，是近20年來配置框架未見的倒掛。
道明證券則指出，黃金短線上承壓，但長線牛市未終。業內人士警告，若10年期美債殖利率飆破5%，全球組合再平衡將不再是微調，而是對「無風險利率錨」本身的重估。從日債破3到美債逼5，市場正為過去40年的長債牛市舉行閉幕式。
paras_en: A synchronized sell‑off that spanned Tokyo, Frankfurt, Sydney and New York swept the long‑bond markets of advanced economies on Wednesday (the 2nd). Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield breached 3% intraday, the first time since October 1996; the US 10‑year yield jumped above 4.8%, a peak not seen since January 2025, while the 30‑year rose to 5.28%. Germany’s and Australia’s 10‑year yields each hit fresh 15‑year‑plus highs, and Bloomberg’s Global Aggregate Bond Index yield rose to 3.72%, the highest since mid‑2008.

Experts say that Middle‑East tensions have pushed oil prices up, reviving inflation expectations. Fed Chair Jerome Powell delivered a hawkish signal at Jackson Hole, and CME’s FedWatch showed the probability of a September rate hike climbing from under 40% to near 70%. Barclays now forecasts a 25‑basis‑point hike in both September and December.

In Japan, US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen urged the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to “further raise rates” during the G20, while Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki downplayed monetary‑policy debate. Nevertheless, the market now sees a near‑99% chance of a BOJ hike this month, steepening the Japanese yield curve and pushing the 10‑year term premium to 150 basis points – a metric Allianz calls a leading indicator that the era of “global zero‑cost funding” is ending.

On the currency front, after a coordinated intervention of ¥15.3993 trillion (about $96.5 billion) by Japan and the United States from July 30 to August 26, the yen still slipped back toward the ¥160 level. The cumulative intervention this year now totals ¥27.13 trillion, surpassing the 2003 record, leading markets to speculate that Tokyo may be forced to sell US Treasuries to support the yen.

A deeper issue is eroding confidence in fiscal policy. Wu Chun‑ye of Five Minerals Securities noted that Powell’s tolerance for inflation has clearly dropped, demanding that underlying inflation “clearly and quickly” return to 2%. Meanwhile, CICC argues that under a “fiscal‑driven” environment, the Fed will find it hard to stay out of the picture.

When the 10‑year US Treasury yields 4.8% represent a risk‑free return, the S&P 500’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio sits at 26× (earnings yield only 3.7%). The equity‑bond risk‑return ratio turns negative – a reversal not seen in the past two decades of asset‑allocation frameworks.

TD Securities points out that gold faces short‑term pressure but the long‑term bull market remains intact. Industry insiders warn that if the 10‑year US Treasury yield breaches 5%, global portfolio rebalancing will shift from a fine‑tuning exercise to a full‑scale reassessment of the “risk‑free rate anchor” itself. From Japan yields breaking 3% to US yields approaching 5%, the market is staging a closing ceremony for the 40‑year long‑bond bull run.

items.title: Fed鷹派聲浪踩煞車！威廉斯：升息理由還不夠
items.title_en: Fed Hawkish Tone Hits the Brakes! Williams: Not Enough Reason to Raise Rates
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周三(2日)表示，近期通膨數據令人鼓舞，隨著關稅造成的一次性價格衝擊逐漸消退，通膨正緩慢下降，目前尚無明確證據顯示Fed必須再次升息。
威廉斯接受《CNBC》訪問時指出，目前推升物價的主要因素仍是關稅，以及中東衝突造成的能源價格上漲，部分服務業通膨也依然偏高。不過，能源成本上升尚未擴散至其他服務項目，Fed也未觀察到關稅引發第二輪通膨效應，通膨預期仍受到控制。
威廉斯說：「最近的數據令人鼓舞。」隨著部分關稅影響逐漸成為過去，通膨趨勢正緩慢下滑，但目前仍無法確定現行貨幣政策是否足以確保未來一至兩年內讓通膨回到目標，或Fed是否必須採取進一步行動。
威廉斯支持聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)7月維持利率不變的決定，並認為目前利率處於適當位置，足以平衡充分就業與物價穩定的雙重使命。不過，他強調Fed仍在蒐集大量數據，之後必須重新評估政策立場。
Fed將於9月15日至16日在華盛頓召開利率會議，此前今年已連續5次按兵不動。7月會議有3名具投票權的官員主張升息1碼，顯示決策官員對政策限制程度看法不一。期貨市場一度反映，Fed本月將利率提高1碼至3.75%至4%的機率約達三分之二，但威廉斯的談話顯示，升息仍非板上釘釘。
身為Fed決策核心人物，威廉斯的立場通常代表政策辯論中的中間派看法。Fed在會議前還將取得一份最新通膨報告，市場也將關注Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四(3日)的談話。
對於近期長期公債殖利率上升，威廉斯認為，主要反映美國經濟與成長前景強勁，以及AI、資料中心和科技領域的龐大投資需求，而非通膨失控或市場出現信用疑慮。
他表示，若未來出現持續性的生產力繁榮，確實可能推升不刺激也不抑制經濟的中性利率，但目前尚未看到足夠證據。威廉斯估計中性利率約為1%，實質利率雖略有上升，幅度仍相當有限。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair and New York Fed President John Williams said on Wednesday (the 2nd) that recent inflation data are encouraging, and as the one‑off price shock from tariffs fades, inflation is slowly easing, with no clear evidence that the Fed needs to raise rates again.

In an interview with CNBC, Williams noted that the main drivers of price pressures remain tariffs and higher energy prices due to the Middle‑East conflict, and some services inflation remains elevated. However, the rise in energy costs has not yet spread to other services, the Fed has not seen a second‑round inflation effect from tariffs, and inflation expectations remain under control.

Williams said, “The recent data are encouraging.” As the impact of some tariffs recedes, the inflation trend is gradually sliding down, but it is still uncertain whether the current monetary policy is sufficient to bring inflation back to target over the next one to two years, or whether the Fed must take further action.

Williams supported the Federal Open Market Committee’s decision to keep rates unchanged in July and said the current rate level is appropriate to balance the dual mandate of full employment and price stability. He emphasized, however, that the Fed is still gathering a large amount of data and will have to reassess its policy stance later.

The Fed will hold its rate‑policy meeting in Washington on September 15‑16, after five consecutive pauses this year. At the July meeting, three voting members advocated a one‑basis‑point hike, showing differing views among policymakers on how restrictive policy should be. Futures once priced a roughly two‑thirds chance that the Fed would raise rates by one basis point to 3.75%‑4% this month, but Williams’s comments suggest a hike is not a foregone conclusion.

As a core member of the Fed’s decision‑making team, Williams’s stance usually reflects a centrist view in policy debates. The Fed will also receive a fresh inflation report before the meeting, and markets will watch Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s remarks on Thursday (the 3rd).

Regarding the recent rise in long‑term Treasury yields, Williams said it mainly reflects a strong U.S. economy and growth outlook, as well as massive investment demand in AI, data centers and the tech sector, rather than runaway inflation or credit concerns in the market.

He added that if a sustained productivity boom materializes, it could indeed push the neutral rate higher—neither stimulating nor restraining the economy—but there is not enough evidence yet. Williams estimates the neutral rate at about 1%, and while real rates have risen slightly, the increase remains modest.
